evidence.detail: 2025-06-29: 'Never overwrite a main-text symbol with an emoji symbol' — generalized the apostrophe exclusion to cover all ASCII alphanumeric characters and apostrophe in the symbols font subsetting

Current code: `remaining_graphemes = {grapheme for grapheme in all_graphemes if not any(c in grapheme for c in "0123456789'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")}` — apostrophe is in the exclusion set, so it is never subsetted into the symbols font
